findings.title: The feasibility kernel counts partial automatic facts as terminal routes and therefore passes a workload that must block
findings.evidence: run_phase7 removes every item having any automatic proposition from the curation residual, then assigns exactly one predicted curated proposition to each remaining item. The proposed schema independently requires one_or_more consumption_form and one_or_more meal_role assertions, and every value on both axes is curated-only. Consequently all 317 items require curation on at least those two axes: the minimum workload is 317 curated items and 634 curated propositions, not 238 and 238. Both sealed caps, 240 items and 480 propositions, are exceeded. The emitted PASS kernel, unrouted_target_count=0, and changes_8_through_13_allowed=true are therefore false.
findings.impact: The mandatory Change 0-7 dominator should have ended this attempt as blocked_feasibility_kernel. Changes 8-13 and the implementation-complete bundle were produced despite a blocking predicate, invalidating the implementation-complete claim.
findings.required_action: Preserve attempt-0018 as failed evidence. In a new attempt from Change 0, compute per-item missing required axes after automatic assertions, derive item and proposition workload from those missing axes, and block unless both exact pre-result caps are satisfied.

findings.title: No executable post-implementation authority path exists despite the tooling-complete claim
findings.evidence: The CLI exposes only kernel, implementation, all, record-validation, seal, and verify. No route consumes owner decisions, semantic approvals, curated approval ledgers, or the external review to call build_candidate_bytes with authority_bearing=true. run_phase11 writes only schemas/templates for successor authorization, selected binding, and sealed receipt, yet reports successor_tooling_implementation_complete=true. Repository search finds no producer for curated_fact_ledger.jsonl, semantic_authority_approval_ledger.jsonl, successor_authorization.json, selected_successor_input_binding.json, or sealed_successor_receipt.json.
findings.impact: The claimed D1/D5-D16 option-capable implementation cannot perform the plan's authorized authority execution or seal a non-current successor after this review.
findings.required_action: Implement a fail-closed authority-execution command that validates the exact bundle, owner decisions and approvals, external review, curated ledgers, schema cardinality, caps, and branch B authorization before producing the authority-bearing candidate, selected binding, and sealed successor receipt.

findings.title: The curation state machine and required crash/rework fixtures are asserted rather than implemented
findings.evidence: validate_curated_rows checks only approver/approval record, rationale, and axis/value; it does not require curator identity, reviewed source set, schema identity, approval state, or authority_class=curated. apply_events_idempotently simply overwrites state by proposition ID and does not validate event transitions, checkpoint hashes, canonical resume cursors, rejection-to-rework routing, or crash recovery. Nevertheless run_phase8 hard-codes curation_crash_boundary_fixtures_pass=true and curation_rejection_rework_fixture_pass=true.
findings.impact: D5-D8 options are not safely executable, and the sealed curation_workflow_option_implementations_complete and implementation machine PASS claims are unsupported.
findings.required_action: Implement the append-only event state machine, full curated-row contract, hash-bound checkpoint/resume validation, rejection/rework behavior, and real crash-before-commit and crash-after-ledger-before-checkpoint fixtures whose results are computed rather than literals.

findings.title: The D16 receipt is caller-authored metadata, not evidence from the actual Phase 2 consumer
findings.evidence: build_food_semantic_no_render_receipt accepts paths and SHA-256 strings from its caller and returns them without opening or hashing any file and without executing an actual Phase 2 inventory path. The validator only compares those supplied strings plus producer/render_write_count; it does not require explicit_non_current_input_override=true or current_facts_read_count=0. A self-declared receipt, including one representing a current-facts read, can therefore pass.
findings.impact: The adopted D16 code cannot establish O-10's actual-consumer four-identity evidence or the Branch B no-current-read boundary, and wrong-input protection can be bypassed by supplied metadata.
findings.required_action: Integrate receipt creation into the actual Phase 2 read path, compute hashes from successfully opened files, bind manifest-to-facts identity, and make the validator enforce the explicit non-current override, current_facts_read_count=0, paths, and all four computed identities with wrong-predecessor and wrong-candidate fixtures.

findings.title: R3 determinism evidence claims seed and locale coverage that was never executed
findings.evidence: run_phase2 invokes execute_r3_signals twice in the same process and changes only member-list order. It then records pythonhashseed_fixture_values=[1,777] and locale_fixture_values=[C,ko-KR] without launching isolated processes, changing either environment, or reversing filesystem traversal.
findings.impact: The plan-required R3 reproducibility proof and the kernel's r3_determinism_validation=PASS predicate are not supported by the implementation or evidence.
findings.required_action: Run the R3 producer in isolated subprocesses under both PYTHONHASHSEED values, the required locale variants, and reversed traversal, then compare canonical signal/lineage bytes and bind actual command/result evidence.

findings.title: The forbidden-inference fixture coverage claim is false
findings.evidence: run_phase9 exercises a single negative row using DisplayName plus display_text_inference, then emits all_forbidden_members_have_detector_fixtures=true. The bound registry contains four forbidden source fields and thirteen forbidden operations, so most members have no detector-positive fixture.
findings.impact: The sealed detector_positive_fixtures_pass and unsupported/arbitrary-inference zero tooling-complete claims do not meet the plan's per-forbidden-member validation contract.
findings.required_action: Generate and execute one positive-detection fixture for every forbidden source field and every forbidden operation, derive the coverage predicate from exact registry member sets, and fail when any member lacks a hit.
